name: GroupedList
access: OML creates this object from a selector:GroupedList node. Reach the instance with find or cfind, then call methods on that instance. Method names are not OML keys.

properties.name: display
properties.description: Display object for the items. Required.

properties.name: list
properties.description: The data, an array or an OGX.List. Optional.

properties.name: group_by
properties.description: Shared property used to group. Optional.

properties.name: group_param
properties.description: numrange can be 500 or [500, '$', 'pre']. date can be [30, 'YYYY-MM']. pre and post place the symbol. Optional.

properties.name: group_order
properties.description: Preferred nest order. See NestList. Optional.

catalog_status: Listed fields are OML config from the OGX.JS wiki. Methods are not listed. Use inherited true for documented base classes. Do not invent members that are absent.
